'''Jorsk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]<ref name="CSWE" /> and commenter on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref> A native of [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]], Jorsk smuggled supplies and weapons to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CSWE" /> While smuggling to the Rebels, Jorsk was caught behind Rebel lines when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] staged an ambush. He was witness to several Rebels using flechette launchers on the interior of a [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|LAVr QH-7 Chariot]] after blowing off the door. While admitting it was a fearsome anti-personnel weapon, Jorsk disliked flechette launchers such as the [[DF-D1 Duo-Flechette Rifle/Legends|DF-D1 Duo-Flechette Rifle]] because of the amount of unnecessary damage they caused and the fact that [[Police officer/Legends|law enforcement officers]] could easily pick them out and find a crime to blame on those who carried them.<ref name="GFT" />

Jorsk had a friend who had started a side-business repairing [[wrist-caster]]s by fixing the firing mechanism and crafting new [[Quarrel/Legends|quarrels]]. He commented on the corresponding entry in the Datalog, as well as the one for the [[Model Q4 hold-out blaster pistol]]. Jorsk received a [[StarSlasher Blaster Carbine]] as a present from his father when the latter retired from smuggling. He loved the weapon, and gifted it to his own son while on a hunting trip.<ref name="GFT" />
